ngs.text:
According to the AP report, the official was surnamed Ma. He was approached and recruited by a foreign intelligence service while working abroad. An operative identified as "Kailin" frequently arranged meetings with him, citing an interest in learning Chinese, and later introduced him to a colleague who threatened to report his earlier disclosures to Chinese authorities if he refused to cooperate.

Ma signed a cooperation agreement with "confidentiality" and "loyalty" clauses and received fixed monthly payments. He provided 35 pieces of information classified as national secrets and received payments worth over 1 million yuan (about $150,000).

He was sentenced to death. The post did not identify the countries involved, say when or where he was sentenced, or say whether he had already been executed.
